cards.subject: The Holy Order of Northshire Clerics
lines: Missionaries of the Holy Light came south from Lordaeron and founded the order here — the kingdom's source of wisdom, comfort and healing, not a barracks.
When the orcs invaded they learned what the clerics could do and hunted down every one they could find. The order was effectively annihilated.

cards.subject: This is why paladins exist
lines: Alonsus Faol founded the Knights of the Silver Hand after learning how the clerics died: healers who could not defend themselves.
A paladin is a Northshire cleric rebuilt so that hunting one is expensive.
The man teaching novices in the Hall of Arms is the far end of that line.

cards.subject: This is the second abbey
lines: In Warcraft I's orc campaign, Northshire Abbey is a playable mission — Doomhammer's forces storm it to free a spy and leave nothing standing.
It is canon.
What you are standing in was rebuilt on those ashes after the Second War.

cards.subject: They pulled the books out of the rubble
lines: Before the survivors fled north with Lothar they salvaged sacred tomes out of the wreckage.
Those rescued texts are what the mages of Dalaran later used to learn Invisibility.
A spell the whole world uses came out of this building's ruins.

cards.subject: The building is a diagram of the Alliance
lines: Main Hall in the centre, Hall of Arms on one flank, Library Wing on the other, with the graveyard and the stable outside.
Warriors, paladins and rogues train on one side. Priests and mages on the other, over two floors.
You can see the whole faction's shape from the doorway.

cards.subject: One door in the mountains
lines: The valley is ringed by impassable rock with a single exception: the pass south, walled in thick stone with a gate on it.
A river crosses the valley and drains out into Crystal Lake.
Everything a new human sees is inside a box with one way out of it.

cards.subject: They do not attack you
lines: The kobolds in the mine are not hostile until they are provoked.
The first creature almost every human character in this game kills never came at them.
McBride sends recruits to clear it on a schedule. It is a chore, not an emergency.

cards.subject: Here, the Defias pull
lines: They were made neutral in patch 3.3.0 and the camp was deleted outright in 4.0.3a.
So the unease you feel walking up to those vines is real, and this is the only version of the game that still has it.
The starting zone used to have something in it that would hurt you.

cards.subject: The trouble started inside the abbey
lines: A student of this school defected to the Defias and took books with him, one of them Powers of the Void.
The warlock trainer who sends you after it wants it for herself.
Paladins are separately sent after a stolen libram. The valley's problem walked out of its own library.

cards.subject: The first enemy with a name
lines: A cutthroat in a shack east of the vineyards. Level five, one thug beside him, a bounty posted on him in the abbey.
You bring back the head.
For most Alliance characters ever made, he is the first thing in the world that was somebody.

cards.subject: He was here before the game was
lines: The garrison commander is among the oldest NPCs still standing in World of Warcraft, present in alpha testing.
He has been handing the same recruits the same kobold problem for the entire life of the franchise.

cards.subject: The wolves came north out of Duskwood
lines: Deputy Willem's explanation for the increase in wolves is that the animals fled up here.
In 1.12 nothing tells you what they were running from.
It is the first hint the human starting zone gives that something is wrong further south.
